title: An Energy-Based Perspective on Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.14383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy-based models (EBMs) define a distribution through a scalar energy, $p_\theta(x)\propto\exp(-E_\theta(x))$, and are usually presented as one model family among many. This tutorial has a broader goal: beyond introducing EBMs, it uses them as a single lens that connects the different aspects of machine learning. Any EBM is specified by three choices, the energy, which determines what the model represents; the inference procedure, which samples from or optimizes the energy; and the learning method, which fits the energy to data. We first develop these components, including sampling, variational inference, and learning by maximum likelihood, noise contrastive estimation, pseudolikelihood, score matching, and adversarial training, and show that the learning methods share one contrastive structure. translated_abstract: 能量模型（EBM）通过一个标量能量函数来定义分布，$p_\theta(x)\propto\exp(-E_\theta(x))$，通常被视为众多模型家族中的一员。本教程有着更宏大的目标：不仅介绍EBM，还将其作为一个统一的视角，把机器学习的不同方面连接起来。任何EBM都由三个选择确定：能量函数，它决定模型表示什么；推断过程，它从能量中采样或对能量进行优化；以及学习方法，它使能量拟合数据。我们首先阐述这些组件，包括采样、变分推断，以及通过最大似然、噪声对比估计、伪似然、得分匹配和对抗训练进行学习的方法，并证明这些学习方法共享同一个对比结构。随后我们展示判别模型、生成模型（如GAN、归一化流、扩散模型和自回归模型）、表示学习等均可在此框架下统一理解（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本教程以能量模型（EBM）为统一视角，通过能量函数、推断过程和学习方法三大核心组件，将判别模型、GAN、扩散模型、自回归模型等各类机器学习方法统一在一个共同的对比学习框架之下。
en_tdlr: This tutorial uses energy-based models as a unifying lens, connecting discriminative models, GANs, diffusion models, and autoregressive models through three core components—the energy, the inference procedure, and the learning method—showing they all share a common contrastive learning structure.
